name: perf-king-normal
js: (()=>{const app=window.__CITY_APP;app.teleportTo(400,-130,0);const cam={pos:[352, 1.7, -290],look:[340, 2, -330],fov:55};app.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>cam;})();(async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await sleep(2500);let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<4000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});console.log('[perf] normal perf-king '+((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(1)+' ms')})()
